_: The normative source of truth for Stella's colour system.
Edit this file, then run `make brand`. Nothing downstream is hand-written:
build.py generates the TUI's palette.rs, the docs site's tokens.css, and the
observatory's :root block from exactly these values. Hand-syncing a hex code
across three crates is what produced the three rival palettes this replaces.
`contracts` and `forbidden` are enforced by build.py on every run -- a token
edit that breaks WCAG AA, or that puts gold on a light ground as text, fails
the build with the measured ratio rather than shipping.
identity: gold on deep navy: a star against night sky
rules: Gold is NEVER text on a light ground -- it is 1.35:1 on white against the 4.5 required. On paper, gold appears only as a FILL under an ink label (14.70:1). Light-mode accent text is ink. gold-ink is the only warm text tone permitted on paper.

Warning is orange, not yellow. Yellow is conventionally 'warning' in a terminal, and making it the brand hue collides; orange separates cleanly. Status must always pair colour with a glyph, never rely on hue alone.
Gold is reserved for brand, active/running, and progress. It is not a general-purpose highlight -- if everything is gold, nothing is.
The wordmark stays ink/paper; the MARK carries the gold. hairline is deliberately below 3.0 contrast and must never be the only thing conveying structure.

groups.title: Ground (dark)
groups.doc: The night sky the whole identity sits on. `ground` is the app background; `surface` and `raised` step up for cards and popovers.

tokens.name: night
tokens.doc: Deepest ground -- full-bleed backdrops, the splash, OG art.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.doc: App background. The default dark canvas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.doc: Card / panel surface, one step above ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.doc: Raised surface -- popovers, selected rows, hovered cells.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.doc: Seam / rule. Deliberately 1.47:1 on ground: decorative only, never the sole carrier of structure.

groups.name: brand
groups.title: Brand
groups.doc: Gold. Reserved for brand, active/running, and progress -- never a general-purpose highlight.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.doc: The brand hue. On dark ground only, or as a fill under an ink label.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.doc: Pressed / gradient-deep stop, and the leading stop of the progress fill.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.doc: The ONLY warm text tone permitted on a light ground -- 6.12:1 on paper.

groups.name: text-dark
groups.title: Text (dark ground)
groups.doc: Cool neutrals for the dark canvas. `text-tertiary` clears AA body text on night and ground only -- see contracts.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.doc: Primary text.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.doc: Secondary text. The safe small-text tone on every dark ground.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.doc: Labels and captions. AA body on night/ground; large-text or UI only on surface/raised.

groups.name: status
groups.title: Status
groups.doc: Always paired with a glyph. Hue alone never carries meaning.

tokens.name: success
tokens.doc: Success / done / added.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.doc: Warning / needs-input. Orange, not yellow -- yellow is the brand hue.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.doc: Error / failed / removed.

groups.name: status-light
groups.title: Status (light ground)
groups.doc: The same three meanings, darkened along their own hue until they clear AA on paper. The dark-ground status tones are light colours -- `success` is 1.72:1 on white -- so a light surface needs its own set for the same reason gold does.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.doc: Success on a light ground -- 5.76:1 on paper.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.doc: Warning on a light ground -- 5.49:1 on paper. Still orange, not yellow.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.doc: Error on a light ground -- 5.88:1 on paper.

groups.name: ground-light
groups.title: Ground (light)
groups.doc: The paper mode. Accent text here is ink, never gold.
